name: Impatient
description:
9% chance per rank for basic abilities to generate 3 extra adrenaline.
This perk has an increased chance to activate on level 20 items.

name: Invigorating
description: Boosts adrenaline gained from basic attacks by 5% per rank.

name: Relentless
description:
1% chance per rank to prevent adrenaline being consumed when using an ability that requires adrenaline.
This perk has an increased chance to activate on level 20 items.

name: Brief Respite
description: Reduces cooldown for Guthix's Blessing and Rejuvenate by 5% per rank, and total healing by 1% of max lifepoints per rank.

name: Bulwark
description: Debilitate deals no damage but gains up to 6% per rank extra duration from shield value.

name: Clear Headed
description: Anticipation lasts one additional second per rank, but no longer reduces damage taken.

name: Crystal Shield
description:
Has a 10% chance to activate on taking damage, lasting 10 seconds. 5% of damage taken per rank is totalled for this period, becoming temporary lifepoints afterwards. These last either 30 seconds or until depleted through further damage. (1 minute cooldown)
This perk has an increased chance to activate on level 20 items.

name: Devoted
description:
3% chance per rank on being hit that protection prayers will work at 100% (or 75% in PvP) for 3 seconds.
This perk has an increased chance to activate on level 20 items.

name: Enhanced Devoted
description:
4.5% chance per rank on being hit that protection prayers will work at 100% (or 75% in PvP) for 3 seconds. This does not stack with devoted.
This perk has an increased chance to activate on level 20 items.

name: Mobile
description: Reduces cooldown of Surge, Escape, Dive, Bladed Dive, Barge and Greater Barge by 50%.

name: Planted Feet
description: The duration of Sunshine and Death's Swiftness is increased by 25%, but they no longer deal periodic damage to your target.

name: Preparation
description: Preparation's duration and cooldown are increased by 15% per rank.

name: Reflexes
description: Anticipation's duration and cooldown are halved.

name: Turtling
description: The Barricade ability's duration and cooldown are both increased by 10% per rank.

name: Aftershock
description: After dealing 50,000 damage, create an explosion centered on your current target, dealing up to 40% per rank to nearby enemies.

name: Biting
description:
+2% chance per rank to critically hit opponents.
This perk has an increased chance to activate on level 20 items.

name: Caroming
description:
Ricochet deals 4% bonus damage per rank, with each hit.
Abilities copied with Chain deal an additional 5% + 5% damage per rank against secondary targets.

name: Crackling
description: Periodically zaps your combat target for 50% per rank of your weapon's damage (or 10% per rank in PvP). (1 minute cooldown)

name: Demon Slayer
description: Deal 7% additional damage to demons.

name: Dragon Slayer
description: Deal +7% damage to dragons.

name: Energising
description: Gain by 50 + 25 per rank accuracy bonus.

name: Equilibrium
description: Ability damage is increased by 6%, plus an additional 2% per rank, but prevents critically striking. (Cannot critically strike for 30s after unequipping this perk).

name: Eruptive
description: Ability damage is increased by 0.5% per rank.

name: Flanking
description: Soul Strike, Backhand, Impact and Binding Shot no longer stun and deal 40% more damage per rank to targets that are not facing you.

name: Genocidal
description: Deal up to +5% extra damage to your current Slayer target proportional to progress through your current task.

name: Lunging
description: The damage of Combust and Dismember is increased by + an additional per rank.

name: Precise
description: Increases your minimum damage by 1.5% per rank of your maximum damage.

name: Ruthless
description: Whenever you defeat an enemy you gain a 0.5% damage boost per rank for 20 seconds. This can stack up to 5 times. (Does not work in PvP areas.)

name: Shield Bashing
description: Debilitate's damage is increased by 15% per rank.

name: Spendthrift
description:
1% chance per rank to deal 1% extra damage per rank, at the cost of 1 gold coin per extra point of damage dealt.
This perk has an increased chance to activate on level 20 items.

name: Ultimatums
description: Ultimate abilities gain base damage per rank.

name: Undead Slayer
description: Deal 7% additional damage to undead.

name: Absorbative
description:
20% chance to reduce an attack by 5% per rank.
This perk has an increased chance to activate on level 20 items.

name: Lucky
description:
0.5% chance per rank when hit that the damage dealt will be reduced to 1. Does not stack with the equivalent Warpriest effect.
This perk has an increased chance to activate on level 20 items.

name: Venomblood
description: Regular poison damage is negated.

name: Brassican
description: Always sometimes cabbages.

name: Breakdown
description: When finishing a smithing item has a 0.8% chance per rank, of giving components as if you would've dissassembled the item. This does not dissassemble the item.

name: Careless
description: While mining, increases your damage by 2% per rank, at the cost of reducing your stamina by an additional 10% per rank. While smithing, increases your base progress per strike by 10% per rank, at the cost of reducing heat by an additional 10% per rank.

name: Charitable
description:
Has a 1% chance per rank of putting an extra item by other nearby players after successfully gathering a resource.
This perk has an increased chance to activate on level 20 items.

name: Efficient
description: Charge drain rate for this item is reduced by 6% per rank.

name: Enhanced Efficient
description: Charge drain rate for this item is reduced by 9% per rank. This does not stack with efficient.

name: Enlightened
description: +3% item XP per rank (for the item it's installed on).

name: Explosive
description: While mining core rocks, your mining damage is increased by 20%, but rockertunities will no longer spawn.

name: Fortune
description: Has a 0.5% chance per rank on gathering skills and 0.1% chance per rank on production skills to double and bank what you have gathered or produced.

name: Furnace
description:
Has a 5% chance per rank of consuming a gathered resource for an extra 100% XP. When mining has a 5% chance per rank to generate no progress, but give double xp.
This perk has an increased chance to activate on level 20 items.

name: Glow Worm
description: Provides light equivalent to a bullseye lantern.

name: Hallucinogenic
description: Causes you to see strange things...

name: Hasty
description: During excavation gives a 1% chance per rank to gain triple excavation progress, at the cost of not receiving a material.

name: Hoarding
description: Protect Item protects two items instead of one. (Does not work in PvP areas.)

name: Honed
description:
Has a 2% per rank higher chance of successfully gathering items. However, while mining you have a 2% chance per rank of mining an additional ore.
This perk has an increased chance to activate on level 20 items.

name: Imp Souled
description:
Has a 3% chance per rank on successful gathering to send the gathered resources to the bank at a cost of 30 prayer points.
This perk has an increased chance to activate on level 20 items.

name: Looting
description: Most enemies have a 25% chance to drop an additional high-level resource. (5 minute cooldown.)

name: Mysterious
description: Has a mysterious effect...

name: Naturalist
description: When successfully gathering from a Woodcutting, Mining or Fishing resource, gives a 0.5% chance per rank to activate a random skill specific buff.

name: Oblivious
description: Increases the number of successive pickpockets you can make by 5 before your target starts to get more suspicious.

name: Polishing
description:
Has a 3% chance per rank of transmuting a gathered resource to a higher tier.
This perk has an increased chance to activate on level 20 items.

name: Preservationist
description: On excavation completion has a 1% chance per rank to gain a restored artefact instead of a damaged artefact.

name: Prosper
description:
Allows you to find clue scrolls whilst skilling and a 1% chance for elite clues found this way to be upgraded to master.
This perk has an increased chance to activate on level 20 items.

name: Pyromaniac
description:
Has a 0.1% chance per rank of burning all logs of the same type from the inventory.

This perk has an increased chance to activate on level 20 items.

name: Rapid
description:
Has a 5% chance per rank to carry out work at a faster pace. However, while smithing has a 5% chance per rank to double your progress while your heat is lost twice as fast.
This perk has an increased chance to activate on level 20 items.

name: Refined
description:
Has a 5% chance per rank of preventing a resource depleting when gathering. However, while mining increases your chance to find geodes by 2% per rank.
This perk has an increased chance to activate on level 20 items.

name: Scavenging
description:
1% chance per rank to get an uncommon Invention component as a drop from combat (with a 1% chance it will be a rare component instead).
This perk has an increased chance to activate on level 20 items.

name: Scraps
description: Gain one additional resource when a material cache is depleted or a tree is felled.

name: Talking
description: Gives your gear more personality.

name: Taunting
description: Provoke affects enemies in a 5x5 square around its target, causing those that are already in combat to attack you.

name: Tinker
description:
Has a 5% chance per rank to carry out higher quality work, awarding an extra 25% XP. While smithing, has a 2% chance per rank to double your progress.
This perk has an increased chance to activate on level 20 items.

name: Trophy-taker's
description:
3% chance per rank a slain creature will add zero kills to its Slayer assignment; 2% chance per rank it will add 2 kills.

This perk has an increased chance to activate on level 20 items.

name: Wild Runes
description: Has a 1% chance per rank to channel the Ourania Altar, providing a random assortment of elemental and catalytic runes in place of those you would have gained at the altar you are using. (Does not work when crafting necrotic runes.)

name: Wise
description: While equipped, +1% per rank additional experience, up to 50,000 XP per day.
